The '''Special Unit briefing room''' was a room located within the [[Special Operations barracks]], which was in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was where the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]] was usually briefed by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Roly Melusar]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
